backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming the restoration of the 'You made me the happiest person in the world' line in CelebrationScreen.tsx with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of each frontend source file describing their Slytherin/Harry Potter theme, key UI text, and component responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS with OKLCH-based light and dark CSS custom property tokens for colors, borders, and sidebar theming.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point titled 'Come Back Saachi' that mounts the React app at the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component rendering a Slytherin-themed full-screen layout with floating particles, a main card asking Saachi to reconnect, and a CelebrationScreen shown after the user clicks Yes.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationScree: Celebration screen with Slytherin confetti and floating emoji particles, featuring a delayed animated card with the heartfelt 'You made me the happiest person in the world ✨' message.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Background decoration component rendering 22 randomly positioned Harry Potter-themed emojis that float upward with varied speeds and opacities.
frontend/src/components/RunawayButton.ts: A 'No' button that runs away on hover/touch and displays randomized Harry Potter-themed quip bubbles to discourage clicking.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Includes an InternetIdentityProvider component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a Slytherin/Harry Potter dark theme using CSS custom properties with oklch colors (emerald, silver, dark stone), Tailwind base/components/utilities, and custom utility classes plus keyframe animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with Slytherin palette tokens (emerald, silver, dark-stone), Cinzel/Crimson Text fonts, custom shadows, border radii, and accordion keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state document (version 33) tracking the Harry Potter/Slytherin-themed 'please come back Saachi' webpage, including architectural rules, known issues, and a list of implemented features like the runaway No button and Yes celebration screen.
